user_guide.title: User Guide
user_guide.description: Detailed documentation on how to use the DIGISPORTS software

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: DIGISPORTS is professional sports competition management software supporting real-time scoring, device connection management, and detailed reporting for martial arts disciplines.
steps: Automatic scoring system with 6 disciplines: Sparring (DOL), Pair Practice (SOL), Self-defense (TUV), Multi-practice (DAL), Martial Arts Music (VON), Combat (DK)
Multi-device connection via Socket.IO with QR Code
Management of competitions, athletes, and judges
Modern flat design interface with dark mode support

sections.title: Supported Disciplines
sections.content: The system fully supports 6 martial arts disciplines:

sections.title: System Requirements
sections.content: To use the software effectively, the system must meet the following requirements:
steps: Network: Stable WiFi or LAN for device connection
Judging device: Tablet/Smartphone with a modern web browser
Browser: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge (latest versions)

sections.title: Step 1: Start the System
sections.content: Start the server and client to begin use:
steps: Run command: npm run dev (or yarn dev)

sections.title: Step 2: Create Connection Room
sections.content: Create a room for judging devices to join:
steps: Go to 'Connection Management' from the home page
Click 'Create Room' to create a new room
System automatically generates Room ID (10 chars) and Desktop UUID (12 chars)
QR Code is generated automatically for sharing
Click 'Download QR' to save the QR code
Share the QR code for judging devices to scan

sections.title: Step 3: Import data from Excel
sections.content: Import match lists and athletes from Excel files:
steps: Excel file needs separate sheets for each discipline (DOL, SOL, TUV, DAL, VON, DK)
System automatically recognizes formats and imports data
Check imported data in the match list

sections.title: Step 4: Judge Configuration
sections.content: Set number of judges and roles for each discipline:
steps: Assign roles: J1, J2, J3..., Field Ref, Scoring Machine

sections.title: Import data from Excel
sections.content: The fastest way to create a competition with many matches:
steps: Select Excel file (.xlsx) with correct formatting
Each sheet corresponds to one discipline
DOL Format: [DOL, ID, Name, Unit, Content]
DK Format: [Match #, Red, Unit, Blue, Unit]
System automatically creates and categorizes matches

sections.title: Match Management
sections.content: View and manage match lists:
steps: View matches in 3 modes: List, Grid, Ranking
Filter by status: Waiting (WAI), Ongoing (IN), Finished (FIN)
Search by match number, athlete name, unit
Click 'Delete' to remove match (only if not started)

sections.title: Update Match Info
sections.content: Edit match info and view judge configuration:
steps: Click 'Update' on the match needing edit
Modal displays full info: Athlete, unit, content

sections.title: View Detailed Scores
sections.content: View detailed scores of finished matches:
steps: Modal displays scores for each judge
For Forms/Music: Shows scores per criteria (Movement, Technique, Power...)
For Combat: Shows scores by round and action
'Judges' section shows list of judges who scored
Can print or export PDF from here

sections.title: Scoring DOL/SOL/TUV/DAL (Forms)
sections.content: Scoring process for performance disciplines:
steps: Press F1 to open device connection management
Register judge permissions for each device (J1, J2, J3...)
Judges enter scores on mobile devices by 5 criteria:
System calculates average (removing high/low if configured)

sections.title: Scoring VON (Martial Arts Music)
sections.content: Scoring process for music discipline:
steps: Press F1 to open device connection management
Register judge permissions for each device
Can exclude athletes from scoring if needed

sections.title: Scoring DK (Combat)
sections.content: Scoring process for combat discipline:
steps: Connect judging devices and assign permissions
System tracks time and calculates points automatically
Can pause, use rest time, or medical time

sections.title: Create Connection Room
sections.content: Create a room for judging devices:
steps: Go to 'Connection Management' from home page
Can edit or delete existing rooms

sections.title: Connect Judging Device
sections.content: Connect mobile device to the system:
steps: Ensure mobile and desktop are on the same WiFi/LAN
Desktop: Go to 'Connection Management' → Show QR
• Or visit URL and enter Room ID + Desktop UUID
Wait for device in connection list

sections.title: Register Judge Permission
sections.content: Assign permissions to connected devices:
steps: View device list in management table
Device notified and can start scoring

sections.title: Manage Connected Devices
sections.content: Device management functions:
steps: View list: Name, role, IP, status
Click 'Disconnect All' to end all sessions

sections.title: Troubleshoot Connection
sections.content: Steps to fix connection issues:
steps: Ensure same network (don't use mobile data)
Check firewall doesn't block Socket.IO port (default: 6789)
Verify Room ID and Desktop UUID

sections.title: Forms Match Report (DOL/SOL/TUV/DAL)
sections.content: View and print reports for performance disciplines:
steps: Or select printer to print directly

sections.title: Martial Arts Music (VON) Report
sections.content: View and print reports for music discipline:
steps: Save as PDF or print directly

sections.title: View Detailed Scores
sections.content: View detailed scores of finished matches:
steps: Can print or export PDF from here

sections.title: Ranking Table
sections.content: View aggregated rankings:
steps: System sorts by high score automatically

sections.title: Printing and Exporting
sections.content: How to print and export reports:
steps: Or select printer to print directly
